chunks: And that certainly Our armies will be victorious.
ai.seo_question: Who are the victorious armies of God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Ghubah* (victory) specifically promised to the Ahl al-Bayt and their true followers, reinforcing the idea that divine support guarantees triumph regardless of temporary numerical inferiority. It serves as a theological foundation for the resilience of the faithful during periods of occultation or political struggle, affirming that 'God's party' will ultimately prevail over all opposing forces.
